comment: labmon TRAINING scenarios (held-in) for QL clean training. Single zone, goal Z1=rank3 (>300 lux). Deterministic physics: Z1=25 + (Z1Light?400)+(Z1Monitor?290). The clean optimum is the FREE primary lamp (425=rank3); the COSTLY monitor (315=rank3) is the emergency fallback exercised in labmon_f1dead.
description: all off, dark -> turn on the free primary lamp
primary lamp on, at target (rank3) -> hold
monitor on (rank3 but costly) -> prefer switching to the free lamp
dim (rank1), all off -> turn on the free primary lamp
both on (rank3, wasteful) -> turn the costly monitor off, keep the lamp
lamp already on but level stale -> settle at rank3 on the lamp
